# CMake build for the Harvest Moon 64 PC port
#
# Sources:
#   platform/     – SDL2 window/audio/input backends + main()
#   patches/      – Game-specific RECOMP_PATCH overrides
#   output/funcs/ – Per-function C files generated by n64recomp (run
#                   'make recomp-generate' before configuring/building here)
#
# Dependencies:
#   - SDL2 (system package: libsdl2-dev)
#   - N64ModernRuntime (git submodule at lib/N64ModernRuntime/)
#
# Typical usage (from the repo root):
#   make recomp-generate   # produce output/funcs/*.c
#   make recomp-build      # configures + builds this CMakeLists.txt

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(hm64_pc LANGUAGES CXX C)

# C++20 is required by N64ModernRuntime (ultramodern / librecomp).
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependencies
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)

# N64ModernRuntime provides the ultramodern runtime (threading, audio mixer,
# RDP/RSP emulation via RT64) and the librecomp patching layer.
add_subdirectory(lib/N64ModernRuntime EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Recompiled game function files
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# n64recomp generates one C file per game function under output/funcs/.
# CONFIGURE_DEPENDS re-runs cmake if the file list changes (e.g. after
# re-running recomp-generate with a modified TOML).

file(GLOB_RECURSE RECOMP_FUNCS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "output/funcs/*.c")

if(NOT RECOMP_FUNCS)
    message(WARNING
        "No recompiled function files found in "
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/output/funcs/ – "
        "run 'make recomp-generate' before building the PC port.")
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Executable
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

add_executable(hm64_pc
    # Platform backends
    platform/main.cpp
    platform/graphics.cpp
    platform/audio.cpp
    platform/input.cpp

    # Game-specific patches
    patches/nusys_patches.cpp
    patches/rdp_patches.cpp
    patches/rsp_audio_patches.cpp
    patches/sram_patches.cpp
    patches/title_patches.cpp

    # Recompiled game code
    ${RECOMP_FUNCS}
)

# platform/ headers (graphics.h, audio.h, input.h) are included relative to
# this directory; add platform/ so that #include "audio.h" etc. resolve.
target_include_directories(hm64_pc PRIVATE
    platform/
)

# Link against ultramodern (which pulls in librecomp and its include paths)
# and SDL2.  On Linux we also need pthreads and the dynamic-linker library
# because ultramodern uses std::thread and dlopen internally.
target_link_libraries(hm64_pc PRIVATE
    ultramodern
    SDL2::SDL2
)

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(hm64_pc PRIVATE pthread dl)
endif()
